case: MySQL/MariaDB ENUM SQL-literal exports across SQL modes
contract: Generated SQL INSERTs reproduce enum values under default, NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES, ANSI_QUOTES, and combined SQL modes on both engines.
The fixture covers an apostrophe label, a backslash label, literal NULL, empty text, and SQL NULL.
Each mode checks expected native enum ordinals and label bytes, then compares copied ordinals and bytes to the source.

mysql.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration enum_sql_mode_contract::value_contract_enum_sql_literals_survive_mysql_sql_modes -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

mariadb.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration enum_sql_mode_contract::value_contract_enum_sql_literals_survive_mariadb_sql_modes -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other enum consumers and SQL mode/session combinations remain open.
This bounded case does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
